protocol.execution_order: cyclic rotation over arms for every question and draw
protocol.model_residency: both models remain resident for every measured arm; model loading and warmup are excluded from online wall time
protocol.distribution_guarantee: the 0.5B model proposes tokens; the 1.5B target verifies each block with speculative acceptance and residual correction

decision.criterion: The implementation and unit tests must preserve the target distribution; the Qwen screen then requires at least 5% aggregate wall-time reduction. Main-model, draft-model and total FLOPs are reported separately rather than treated as interchangeable costs.
